description: This file defines functions and types for managing outbound messaging sessions, including resolving session routes, building session keys, and ensuring session entries. It interacts with channel plugins, session storage, and message context handling.

methods.name: resolveOutboundChannelPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves the channel plugin for a given channel ID.

methods.name: stripProviderPrefix
methods.description: Removes the provider prefix from a raw string based on the channel.

methods.name: stripKindPrefix
methods.description: Removes common kind prefixes (user, channel, group, etc.) from a string.

methods.name: inferPeerKind
methods.description: Infers the chat type (direct, channel, group) based on the resolved target kind and plugin capabilities.

methods.name: buildBaseSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a base session key using configuration, agent ID, channel, and peer info.

methods.name: resolveFallbackSession
methods.description: Creates a session route object based on a target string when no specific resolver is available.

methods.name: resolveOutboundSessionRoute
methods.description: Resolves the outbound session route, either via plugin resolver or fallback.

methods.name: ensureOutboundSessionEntry
methods.description: Ensures a session entry exists in storage, recording session metadata.
